server_info.name: SVC Agent API
server_info.description: Read authorized SVC data and safely use the write operations authorized for this connection.

owner/all_scopes.instructions: First call context.get; select only workspace and resource IDs returned by SVC and never guess an ID. For time tracking, use projects.list to match projects, tasks.list only when available and needed, and time_entries.log for completed work with the exact date, whole minutes, description, and a stable idempotency key. Reuse a key only for an identical retry and never approve time unless the user asks. Read an existing record before updating or deleting it and supply its current opaque version. Authorized write tools are enabled for this connection. Read the current record before mutation and supply its opaque version when required. When the user asks to approve time they are logging, pass approve: true to time_entries.log instead of a separate approve call; with time:read and while time_entries.list remains enabled, it returns the rows as time_entries.list does, otherwise it returns the plain write shape. Obtain explicit user confirmation before issue, send, void, correct, activating an agreement, terminating an agreement, expense_schedules.generate, releasing automatic delivery, or generating a cadence draft. Obtain explicit user confirmation before billing_schedules.generate: it issues invoices and may schedule automatic client delivery. Obtain explicit user confirmation before creating, updating, archiving projects or changing project member access; these decisions affect client visibility and access. Obtain explicit user confirmation before sending or accepting a proposal. Sending publishes it in the client portal without emailing. Acceptance signs and activates an agreement; require an explicit signer name and never infer acceptance from a request to read or create a proposal. Obtain explicit user confirmation before deleting an attachment. When the user confirms issuing a draft for money already collected elsewhere, pass payment to invoices.issue so it is issued and paid in one step and the automatic client delivery is never sent; never infer a payment from an invoice balance. Authenticate using OAuth Authorization Code with S256 PKCE. Invoice responses provide a browser URL for any payment flow; payments.record records money already received but never initiates a charge, and SVC does not expose card data or file uploads through MCP. Use the log-time-across-projects and prepare-invoice-safely prompts for complete guided workflows when the client exposes MCP prompts.

tools.name: agreements.activate
tools.title: Activate agreement
tools.description: Activate a draft or paused agreement so it governs billing. Requires explicit user confirmation and the current version. Overlapping active agreements are refused.

tools.name: agreements.create
tools.title: Create agreement
tools.description: Create a client-wide draft agreement using the parent client version. Amounts are minor units and retainer_minutes are whole minutes. It bills nothing until activated.

tools.name: agreements.get
tools.title: Get agreement
tools.description: Get one agreement and its derived recurring billing terms.

tools.name: agreements.list
tools.title: List agreements
tools.description: List active or historical agreement terms visible to a workspace manager.

tools.name: agreements.terminate
tools.title: Terminate agreement
tools.description: End an agreement using the current version after explicit user confirmation. Termination is irreversible. ends_on defaults to today in the workspace timezone, never extending an earlier end or ending before the start.

tools.name: agreements.update
tools.title: Update agreement
tools.description: Correct only the terms sent using the current version. Omitted fields are unchanged; nullable fields can be cleared. Status and signature cannot be edited here.

tools.name: attachments.delete
tools.title: Delete attachment
tools.description: Delete a generic file using its current version, only after explicit user confirmation. The file becomes unavailable immediately and is purged after retention.

tools.name: attachments.download_url
tools.title: Get attachment download URL
tools.description: Prepare a ten-minute signed download URL. Use the same bearer credential; current files:read and manager permission remain required.

tools.name: attachments.get
tools.title: Get attachment
tools.description: Get generic file metadata and current version. Workspace managers only.

tools.name: attachments.list
tools.title: List attachments
tools.description: List up to 100 generic files on a tenant-owned record, with its parent version. Workspace managers only; expense receipts use separate tools.

tools.name: attachments.upload_url
tools.title: Prepare attachment upload
tools.description: Prepare a ten-minute signed multipart REST upload URL without uploading bytes. POST file and expected_version there with the same bearer credential and a fresh Idempotency-Key. Upload retries with the same key and identical bytes return the first attachment. Current files:write and manager permission remain required.

tools.name: billing.audit_missing_billed_overage
tools.title: Audit missing billed overage
tools.description: Get aggregate counts of charged invoices missing billed-overage data.

tools.name: billing.audit_opening_rollover
tools.title: Audit opening rollover
tools.description: Get aggregate counts of agreements whose opening rollover changes their capacity ledger.

tools.name: billing.audit_undated_collectible_invoices
tools.title: Audit undated collectible invoices
tools.description: Get aggregate counts and per-currency balances for collectible invoices without due dates.

tools.name: billing.audit_unplaceable_invoices
tools.title: Audit unplaceable invoices
tools.description: Get aggregate counts of invoices whose billing period or cycle cannot be placed safely.

tools.name: billing_audit.stale_and_missing
tools.title: Audit stale drafts and missing periods
tools.description: Workspace managers only. Count past-due drafts and active recurring agreements lacking a non-void invoice for their current retainer period, with balances per currency and up to 100 identifiers per category.

tools.name: billing_schedules.create
tools.title: Create billing schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring billing schedule for an explicit company and agreement. Use the agreement version as expected_version. Does not issue invoices.

tools.name: billing_schedules.generate
tools.title: Generate scheduled invoices
tools.description: Generate and issue all due invoices through today, only after explicit confirmation. Requires the current schedule version. Never emails directly; normal automatic delivery settings apply.

tools.name: billing_schedules.get
tools.title: Get billing schedule
tools.description: Get one bounded recurring billing schedule.

tools.name: billing_schedules.list
tools.title: List billing schedules
tools.description: List bounded recurring billing schedules visible to a workspace manager.

tools.name: capacity_ledger.get
tools.title: Get capacity ledger
tools.description: Get a bounded trailing window of the computed agreement capacity ledger.

tools.name: clients.archive
tools.title: Archive client
tools.description: Deactivate a client using the current version. Invoices, time, payments and agreements are retained; restore reverses it.

tools.name: clients.create
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: Create a client company. Retry only an identical request with the same key.

tools.name: clients.get
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: Get one client company, its current version and invoice-delivery settings.

tools.name: clients.list
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List client companies visible to a workspace manager, including archived clients unless filtered.

tools.name: clients.restore
tools.title: Restore client
tools.description: Reactivate an archived client using the current version.

tools.name: clients.update
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: Change only the fields sent using the current version. Omitted fields are unchanged and nullable fields can be cleared. Enabling automatic delivery requires a non-null delay and configured invoice recipients. Disabling automatic delivery cancels pending deliveries.

tools.name: context.get
tools.title: Get context
tools.description: Get the authorized identity, workspaces, roles, and capabilities. Call this before selecting a workspace.

tools.name: expense_schedules.create
tools.title: Create expense schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring draft expense schedule using the current client version.

tools.name: expense_schedules.generate
tools.title: Generate scheduled expenses
tools.description: Materialize due draft expenses only after explicit user confirmation. Bounded to 24 occurrences; never approves or invoices them.

tools.name: expense_schedules.list
tools.title: List expense schedules
tools.description: List expense schedules as a workspace manager with bounded cursor pagination.

tools.name: expense_schedules.update
tools.title: Update expense schedule
tools.description: Update or pause a schedule using its current version. Anchor and cadence are immutable.

tools.name: expenses.approve
tools.title: Approve expense
tools.description: Approve one draft expense using its current version as a workspace manager.

tools.name: expenses.delete
tools.title: Delete draft expense
tools.description: Soft-delete a draft expense using its current version. Approved, invoiced and unknown statuses are refused.

tools.name: expenses.list
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List authorized expenses with bounded cursor pagination. Unattributed expenses are visible only to workspace managers.

tools.name: expenses.log
tools.title: Record expenses
tools.description: Idempotently record up to 20 draft expenses as a workspace manager. Amounts use minor units; no receipt attachment or approval.

tools.name: expenses.receipts.download
tools.title: Download expense receipt
tools.description: Get a ten-minute receipt download URL. The URL still requires the same expenses:read bearer credential and manager access.

tools.name: expenses.receipts.list
tools.title: List expense receipts
tools.description: List available receipts for an expense as a workspace manager; at most 100 newest receipts.

tools.name: expenses.receipts.upload_url
tools.title: Prepare expense receipt upload
tools.description: Get a ten-minute multipart upload URL and current expense version. Upload with the same expenses:read and expenses:write bearer credential, Idempotency-Key header, file and expected_version form fields. Preparing a URL does not upload a receipt.

tools.name: expenses.unapprove
tools.title: Unapprove expense
tools.description: Return one approved uninvoiced expense to draft using its current version.

tools.name: expenses.update
tools.title: Update draft expense
tools.description: Replace draft expense facts using the current version. Only workspace managers may write.

tools.name: invoices.add_time
tools.title: Add time to draft
tools.description: Add explicit approved unallocated time to an ad-hoc draft, or regenerate an eligible generated draft with selected work in its service period. Generated drafts recalculate their whole period through the canonical billing engine.

tools.name: invoices.correct
tools.title: Correct issued invoice
tools.description: Correct an unpaid issued invoice that has not been emailed to the client, only after the user explicitly confirms: its due date and/or line wording, and amounts only on operator-authored lines. Omit lines to keep them; supplied lines must name every existing line. A reason is required and kept in the client history; any automatic client delivery is held for explicit release after review. Paid, sent and void invoices are refused.

tools.name: invoices.create_draft
tools.title: Create invoice draft
tools.description: Create a draft from explicit manual lines and/or explicit approved time.

tools.name: invoices.discard_draft
tools.title: Discard invoice draft
tools.description: Discard a draft and release its selected time only after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: invoices.generate_period
tools.title: Generate cadence period draft
tools.description: Create a draft selling an explicit started retainer cycle on an active recurring agreement. period_start is the retainer cycle start; service dates cover the preceding work cycle. No automatic cadence generation job is deployed. A different key for an existing non-void invoice is refused. Explicit confirmation and current agreement version required.

tools.name: invoices.get
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one authorized invoice. The response includes a browser URL for paying. See context.get withheld_tools for payment-recording availability; payment recording never initiates a charge.

editable.description: True only for an ad-hoc draft, the one kind invoices.update_draft accepts; a generated draft is regenerated instead.

automatic_delivery_status.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

automatic_delivery_due_at.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

tools.name: invoices.hold_delivery
tools.title: Hold invoice delivery
tools.description: Hold scheduled or failed automatic delivery using the current invoice version.

tools.name: invoices.issue
tools.title: Issue invoice

payment.description: Money already received for this draft, recorded in the same transaction so the invoice is issued and paid or not changed at all. Requires the payments:record OAuth scope, a workspace owner/admin, and the payment write cutover; never initiates a charge, refuses overpayment, and cancels the automatic client delivery that issuing schedules.

tools.description: Issue a draft invoice using its current version, only after the user explicitly confirms. Issuing never emails the client itself: if the client company has automatic invoice email enabled, a delivery is scheduled for after its configured delay, otherwise none is. SVC also queues its usual internal issued-invoice notice to the workspace administrator. For money already collected elsewhere, such as a card autopay, pass payment (owner/admin, payments:record) to record it in the same transaction: the invoice ends paid or partially paid, the scheduled client delivery is cancelled before it can send, and if any part is refused nothing is written. A payment never initiates a charge and overpayment is refused. With billing:read, and while invoices.get remains enabled, the response matches invoices.get; otherwise it is the plain mutation shape.

outputSchema.description: REST returns the invoice mutation shape. MCP returns the invoice exactly as invoices.get does when the token also holds billing:read and invoices.get is enabled, and the mutation shape otherwise.

editable.description: True only for an ad-hoc draft, the one kind invoices.update_draft accepts; a generated draft is regenerated instead.

automatic_delivery_status.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

automatic_delivery_due_at.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

tools.name: invoices.list
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List authorized invoices with bounded cursor pagination.

editable.description: True only for an ad-hoc draft, the one kind invoices.update_draft accepts; a generated draft is regenerated instead.

automatic_delivery_status.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

automatic_delivery_due_at.description: Workspace managers only; null for other viewers.

tools.name: invoices.pdf
tools.title: Get invoice PDF link
tools.description: Return a signed invoice PDF download URL valid for five minutes. The download requires the current authenticated connection or browser session and rechecks invoice visibility.

tools.name: invoices.release_delivery
tools.title: Release invoice delivery
tools.description: Release held automatic delivery only after explicit user confirmation, using the current invoice version.

tools.name: invoices.send
tools.title: Send invoice
tools.description: Queue delivery to explicit recipients only after confirmation.

tools.name: invoices.update_details
tools.title: Update draft invoice details
tools.description: Change the due date and/or notes of any draft invoice, including a generated draft that invoices.update_draft refuses, using its current version. Lines and linked time are unchanged. Use this before issuing a draft whose due date has passed: a due date may not precede the issue date, and a draft without one is issued today.

tools.name: invoices.update_draft
tools.title: Update invoice draft
tools.description: Replace an ad-hoc draft invoice's selection and lines using its current version. Only a draft that invoices.get reports as editable is accepted; a generated draft (any other invoice_kind) is regenerated in SVC, never edited here.

tools.name: invoices.void
tools.title: Void invoice
tools.description: Void an invoice only after explicit confirmation and reason.

tools.name: operations.summary
tools.title: Get workspace summary
tools.description: Get the role- and scope-filtered operational summary for one workspace.

tools.name: payments.correct
tools.title: Correct received payment
tools.description: Correct the method, reference or received date of a payment already recorded, using the version from payments.list and a reason that is kept in the client history. Omitted fields are unchanged; a null reference clears it. Amount, currency, status and refunds cannot be changed here. Idempotency key required. Owner/admin only. Never charges a customer or issues a refund.

tools.name: payments.list
tools.title: List received payments
tools.description: List payments for an explicit invoice or client company, following invoice visibility with bounded pagination. No private reconciliation or processor identifiers are returned.

tools.name: payments.record
tools.title: Record received payment
tools.description: Record money already received using an explicit invoice, amount in minor units, currency, payment date and method. Idempotency key required. Owner/admin only; overpayments refused. Never charges a customer or issues a refund.

tools.name: projects.archive
tools.title: Archive project
tools.description: Archive a project as a workspace owner/admin only after explicit user confirmation, using its current version. No tasks, time, or financial history are deleted.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: projects.create
tools.title: Create project

repository.description: Repository remote or canonical host/owner/repository; stored in canonical form.

tools.description: Create a project for a client as a workspace owner/admin only after explicit user confirmation. Read the client company first and supply its current version.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: projects.get
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get one authorized project and its visible tasks.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: projects.list
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List authorized projects with bounded cursor pagination.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: projects.members.list
tools.title: List project access
tools.description: List eligible workspace members and their current project roles as a workspace owner/admin, with bounded pagination. Includes none for members without project access; returns the current project version.

tools.name: projects.members.update
tools.title: Set project access
tools.description: Set an existing workspace member project role, or remove it with none, as a workspace owner/admin only after explicit user confirmation. Read projects.members.list for public member IDs and the project version. Workspace owners/admins cannot receive explicit project grants.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: projects.update
tools.title: Update project

repository.description: Repository remote or canonical host/owner/repository; stored in canonical form.

tools.description: Update project facts or client visibility as a workspace owner/admin only after explicit user confirmation, using the current project version. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears description or repository.

repository.description: Canonical host/owner/name this project is worked in, or null when unmapped. Absent entirely for a portal client, who is not shown internal repository names.

tools.name: proposals.accept
tools.title: Accept proposal
tools.description: Only after explicit user confirmation, accept a sent proposal using the current version and explicit signer identity. Signs and activates its agreement. Authorized portal recipients within their project grants, or workspace managers recording offline acceptance, only.

tools.name: proposals.create
tools.title: Create proposal
tools.description: Create a draft proposal as a workspace manager, using the current client company version. Items use minor-unit amounts. Creating does not send it.

tools.name: proposals.get
tools.title: Get proposal
tools.description: Read an authorized proposal and current version before sending or accepting.

tools.name: proposals.list
tools.title: List proposals
tools.description: List authorized proposals with their current version and commercial terms. Portal members see only sent or accepted proposals within their company and project grants.

tools.name: proposals.send
tools.title: Send proposal
tools.description: Only after explicit user confirmation, mark a draft proposal sent and make it available in the client portal. Does not email a recipient. Workspace managers only; current proposal version required.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search workspace
tools.description: Search up to five authorized results per kind in one workspace. Each kind also requires its read scope; missing scopes produce no results for that kind.

tools.name: tasks.create
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task in an authorized project.

tools.name: tasks.get
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get one authorized task.

tools.name: tasks.list
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List authorized tasks with bounded cursor pagination.

tools.name: tasks.update
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: Update an authorized task using its current version.

tools.name: time_entries.approve
tools.title: Approve time
tools.description: Approve a bounded batch of draft time entries after version checks.

tools.name: time_entries.delete
tools.title: Delete editable time
tools.description: Soft-delete authorized draft time, or approved time on a regenerable draft invoice, using its current version.

tools.name: time_entries.list
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List authorized time entries and their tenant-owned invoice allocation with bounded cursor pagination. Use unallocated: true for exactly the approved, priced, billable, non-deferred work counted in operations.summary; allocation_state filters all rows by allocation, including draft and deferred work.

invoice_id.description: Public id of the tenant-owned invoice allocating this time; null when unallocated.

allocation_state.description: No allocation, a draft-invoice reservation, or an allocation to a non-draft invoice. Legacy approved status does not imply unallocated.

client_visible_description.description: The text a client reads on the invoice. `description` stays the internal note for anyone on the worker's side of the entry; a portal client receives this text there too and never the internal note.

tools.name: time_entries.log
tools.title: Log time

approve.description: Approve the logged entries in the same transaction. Requires the time:approve OAuth scope, a user who can approve time on every project, and the agent write cutover; if approval is refused nothing is logged.

is_visible_to_client.description: When omitted, defaults to true if client_visible_description contains text. Send false to keep the entry hidden while staging client text.

client_visible_description.description: Client-facing text. When supplied without is_visible_to_client, the entry defaults to client-visible.

billing_rate_amount.description: Explicit rate in minor units; requires the time:approve OAuth scope and a user who can approve project time.

tools.description: Idempotently log up to 20 completed time entries. When time:read is held and time_entries.list remains enabled, the response matches time_entries.list, including its role rule for rates; if that list capability is disabled, the response uses the plain write shape. If client_visible_description is supplied and is_visible_to_client is omitted, the entry defaults to client-visible; send false to stage client text privately. Pass approve: true to approve them in the same call, only when the user asked for approval; approving and explicit billing rates require time:approve and a project approver role.

invoice_id.description: Public id of the tenant-owned invoice allocating this time; null when unallocated.

allocation_state.description: No allocation, a draft-invoice reservation, or an allocation to a non-draft invoice. Legacy approved status does not imply unallocated.

client_visible_description.description: The text a client reads on the invoice. `description` stays the internal note for anyone on the worker's side of the entry; a portal client receives this text there too and never the internal note.

tools.name: time_entries.unapprove
tools.title: Withdraw time approval
tools.description: Return approved time to draft as a workspace owner or admin using its current version. Time on a draft invoice is released and that invoice regenerated in the same transaction. Billed time and time on issued, paid or void invoices are refused.

invoice_id.description: Public id of the tenant-owned invoice allocating this time; null when unallocated.

allocation_state.description: No allocation, a draft-invoice reservation, or an allocation to a non-draft invoice. Legacy approved status does not imply unallocated.

client_visible_description.description: The text a client reads on the invoice. `description` stays the internal note for anyone on the worker's side of the entry; a portal client receives this text there too and never the internal note.

tools.name: time_entries.update
tools.title: Update editable time
tools.description: Update authorized draft time, or approved time on a regenerable draft invoice, using its current version.

invoice_id.description: Public id of the tenant-owned invoice allocating this time; null when unallocated.

allocation_state.description: No allocation, a draft-invoice reservation, or an allocation to a non-draft invoice. Legacy approved status does not imply unallocated.

client_visible_description.description: The text a client reads on the invoice. `description` stays the internal note for anyone on the worker's side of the entry; a portal client receives this text there too and never the internal note.

tools.title: Create workspace
tools.description: Create a workspace owned by the authenticated user. A new tenant has no expected version; an actor/client/idempotency key reservation prevents duplicate creation.
